We are so happy with our new addition, Thor. His overall demeanour is calm and so patient even though he's a puppy. We are very impressed by how well behaved he is. He isn't reactive to anything!!

Thor is such a well-mannered, intelligent, and loving dog. He was crate, potty and leash trained when we took him home. We have a 8 year old French bulldog and a 5 year old son and they immediately all became brothers!  We were looking for a new dog that would get along with small children and other dogs and it was an easy transition with Thor.

We’re so grateful to have him as part of our family and highly recommend his trainer to anyone looking for someone who genuinely cares about the dogs they work with!

From the moment I got Archie, I knew I had made the right decision. Not only did I get my amazing boy from them, but I also really appreciate the care, knowledge, and support they provide when it comes to training and raising a dog.

It means so much to have someone you can trust and turn to for guidance throughout your dog’s journey. Archie is such a special part of my life, and I’m so grateful that our paths crossed. If you’re looking for someone who genuinely cares about their dogs and wants the best for them, I would absolutely recommend them! 🐾
